title: Checklist card in the dashboard chat
goal: Showing a list renders a validated checklist card whose ticks update the store
acceptance: The card is a registered component with validated data, not generated HTML
Ticking updates the store and other open cards; keyboard and screen-reader accessible (AXE passes)
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A change of gate class, data leaving the base, or a material effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 from the owner jobs case study, before design. Not a measurement.
